notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
description:
Activate Savage Thallid's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling, targeting itself.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.
